Vantor Interactive Imagery Explorer Shiny Module Server

Source: R/vantor_shiny.R
vantor_explorer_server.Rd

Server logic for the vantor_explorer_ui() Shiny module. Renders an interactive leaflet map with Vantor Vivid basemaps, updates layers via leaflet::leafletProxy(), queries WFS seamlines for the current viewport, and provides a shiny::downloadHandler() with progress bar integration for exporting GeoTIFFs via get_maxar_wms_basemap() or get_maxar_wms_tiles().

Usage

vantor_explorer_server(
  id,
  initial_bbox = c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -104.98, ymax = 39.75),
  auth_reactive = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

id

Character string. The Shiny module namespace ID.

initial_bbox

Numeric vector of length 4 (c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in EPSG:4326) or any spatial object supported by vantor_as_bbox() defining the initial map view. Defaults to downtown Denver, CO.

auth_reactive

Optional shiny::reactive returned by vantor_auth_server() to automatically refresh map layers when credentials change.

verbose

Logical. Print status messages to the R console. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

A list of shiny::reactive expressions:

  • bbox: Reactive sf::bbox (EPSG:4326) of the current map viewport

  • seamlines: Reactive sf object of WFS seamlines when inspected

  • product: Reactive selected Vivid product name

  • resolution: Reactive selected ground resolution in meters

Examples

if (requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    explorer <- vantor_explorer_server("explorer", verbose = FALSE)
  }
}
